summary_en: Metaplanet will acquire 96.93 million shares (7.1% of outstanding shares) through ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of 261 yen on October 13, 2026, for a total of 25.3 billion yen, with settlement on October 14, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On October 13, 2026, Metaplanet's board of directors decided to acquire 96,934,800 shares of its own common stock through an off-hours trading transaction (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition will be executed at the closing price of 261 yen on October 13, 2026, for a total consideration of approximately 25.3 billion yen. This represents 7.1% of the company's outstanding common shares as of September 30, 2026. The trading will take place during the morning session of ToSTNeT-3 on October 14, 2026, at 8:45 a.m., and results will be announced immediately following the transaction. This execution is conducted under the acquisition authorization framework approved on the same date, which permits the company to acquire up to 200 million shares (14.7% of outstanding shares) for up to 6 billion yen through market purchases from October 14, 2026 to October 13, 2027.
